Metadata.Goal: Sync the TypeScript Kon parser syntax with ExtensibleScopedRowType while preserving Knl, Kon, and Kjson profile differences.
Metadata.Description: Sync the TypeScript Kon parser syntax with ExtensibleScopedRowType while preserving Knl, Kon, and Kjson profile differences.

TaskSpace.name: sync-kon-parser-syntax
TaskSpace.Description: Sync the TypeScript Kon parser syntax with ExtensibleScopedRowType while preserving Knl, Kon, and Kjson profile differences.

Task.name: Add profile separator tests
Task.Description: Add failing tests that prove Knl and Kon reject comma separators in arrays/vectors and maps while accepting whitespace-separated entries.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Knl whitespace-separated vector and map inputs are covered.
Kon whitespace-separated vector and map inputs are covered.
Knl and Kon comma-separated array/map inputs are rejected.

Task.name: Port external Kon parser syntax tests
Task.Description: Port parser and formatter syntax cases from the external Kon test suite into local tests for KnConverter.Kon.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Chain name, generic params, in/out table, conf, body, sections, slots, attrs, and call syntax are covered.
`.:` and `::` chain operations are covered.
`:::` source-qualified names, including namespaced sources such as `com.example.ClassA:::b`, are covered.
Quote, unquote, unquote splice, and unquote map forms are covered.

Task.name: Extend lexer token support
Task.Description: Update lexer rules to support external Kon token forms needed by the parser.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: `::` is tokenized distinctly for container subscript parsing.
`:::` is tokenized by longest match as a source qualifier, not as `::` plus `:`.
`.:` is tokenized distinctly for static slot/index parsing.
`..name` row spread input can be parsed.
Required word/operator forms such as `?`, `->`, and `--` are tokenized.

Task.name: Add AST structures for Kon parity
Task.Description: Add or extend model nodes to preserve external Kon parser structures without changing interpreter behavior.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: In/out table nodes preserve inputs, outputs, and table kind.
Quote nodes preserve quote kind and inner value.
Word/name nodes preserve source qualifier and member name for `source:::member` syntax.
Chain/knot fields preserve prefixes, postfixes, generics, conf, body, attrs, sections, slots, and subscript operations.

Task.name: Implement whitespace-only separators for Knl and Kon
Task.Description: Update Knl and Kon array/map parsing so whitespace separates entries and comma separators are rejected.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Comma separators fail in Knl and Kon array/map containers.
Kjson JSON-like behavior remains covered and unaffected.

Task.name: Implement external Kon value and chain parser parity
Task.Description: Implement parser support for external Kon value, map, array, chain, in/out table, quote, row spread, source-qualified word, prefix, postfix, generic, attr, conf, body, section, slot, and subscript constructs.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Ported external Kon parser tests pass locally.
No interpreter behavior changes are required to parse and format the new forms.

Task.name: Implement formatter round-trip parity
Task.Description: Update formatter output so Kon syntax round-trips with external Kon style while Knl and Kjson keep their profile styles.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Kon parser/formatter round-trip tests pass.
Knl, Kon, and Kjson formatter outputs keep their configured container styles.

Task.name: Confirm external source qualifier baseline
Task.Description: Record the external ExtensibleScopedRowType baseline where `:::` is source qualification, `::` is container subscript, and `.:` is slot/static subscript.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Track documents that external code and docs now agree on `:::` / `::` / `.:` roles.
Track keeps `::` as container subscript and does not reuse it for source qualification.

Task.name: Run verification suite
Task.Description: Run local TypeScript checks and parser tests, recording any toolchain blockers.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Relevant parser and formatter tests have been run.
TypeScript compile or an equivalent scoped check has been run, with blockers documented if present.

cdt:Check.command: npx tsc --noEmit --target es2018 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck lib/Converter/KnConverter.ts

cdt:VerificationSummary.cdt:Check: Scoped TypeScript source check for the converter entry passed.
Project tsconfig still uses removed TypeScript option suppressImplicitAnyIndexErrors.
Full suite still has legacy interpreter/formatter failures outside this parser-only track; the new Kon parser syntax suite passes.
